{{Current events|year=2026|month=04|day=20|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present)|Middle Eastern crisis]]
**[[2026 Iran war]]
***[[2025–2026 Iran–United States negotiations]]
****[[2026 Iran war ceasefire]]
*****A Iranian official says that [[Iran]] may attend [[ceasefire]] talks with the [[United States]] in [[Islamabad]], [[Pakistan]], following moves by Pakistan to end the [[2026 United States naval blockade of Iran|blockade]] of Iranian ports. However, a decision hasn't been made. [https://www.straitstimes.com/world/middle-east/world-weighs-fate-of-mideast-ceasefire-after-us-seizes-iranian-cargo-ship (''Straits Times'')]
*****[[List of speakers of the Parliament of Iran|Iranian parliament speaker]] [[Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf]] says that Iran is not going to negotiate while it is being threatened. [https://aje.news/3i78ht?update=4508702 (Al Jazeera)]
*****[[President of the United States|United States president]] [[Donald Trump]] says that he is "highly unlikely" to renew the ceasefire when it expires in two days. [https://apnews.com/article/us-iran-war-israel-hormuz-20-april-2026-a3ddc59230ae7de719a9ff9e7595e375 (AP)]
***[[2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis]]
****The [[cruise ship]] ''[[Aroya (ship)|Aroya]]'' arrives in the [[Gulf of Oman]], becoming the final of six cruise ships in the [[Middle East]] to cross the [[Strait of Hormuz]] since the war started on February 28. [https://www.seatrade-cruise.com/ship-operations/the-last-gulf-stranded-cruise-ship-clears-strait-of-hormuz (Seatrade Cruise News)] [https://people.com/6-cruise-ships-stuck-in-the-middle-east-clear-the-strait-of-hormuz-11954315 (People.com)]
**[[Hezbollah–Israel conflict]]
***[[2026 Lebanon war]]
****The [[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli military]] launches [[airstrike]]s in [[southern Lebanon]] against individuals that it accused of posing a threat to [[northern Israel]] or to [[Israeli Ground Forces|Israeli troops]], violating the [[2026 Lebanon war ceasefire|ceasefire]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/world/iran/live-blog/live-updates-iran-war-us-seizes-ship-trump-blockade-hormuz-peace-talks-rcna340930/rcrd108371?canonicalCard=true (NBC News)]
***[[2026 Israel–Lebanon peace talks]]
****The [[United States]] announces that another round of talks between [[Israel]] and [[Lebanon]] will be held in [[Washington, D.C.]], on April 23. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/4/20/lebanon-israel-to-meet-again-thursday-for-direct-talks-us-says (Al Jazeera)]
****[[President of Lebanon|Lebanese president]] [[Joseph Aoun]] announces that he is appointing a new negotiator for the next talks, former ambassador [[Simon Karam]]. [https://aje.news/3i78ht?update=4508439 (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Russo-Ukrainian war]]
**[[Crimea attacks (2022–present)|Crimea attacks]]
***[[Armed Forces of Ukraine|Ukrainian forces]] say they have struck two [[Russian Navy]] [[Dock landing ship|landing ships]] docked at [[Sevastopol Naval Base]] in [[Russian occupation of Crimea|Russian-occupied]] [[Crimea]]. Separately, a Ukrainian [[drone warfare|drone attack]] on [[Tuapse oil terminal]] in [[Krasnodar Krai]], [[Russia]], kills one person and causes several large fires at the facility. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/4/20/kyiv-claims-to-hit-russian-landing-ships-as-both-sides-trade-deadly-attacks (Al Jazeera)]
**[[Terrorism in Russia]]
***[[Russia]]'s [[Federal Security Service]] says it has arrested a [[Germans in Russia|German]] woman and a [[Central Asia]]n man in [[Pyatigorsk]], [[Stavropol Krai]], and seizes an [[improvised explosive device]], alleging they planned an attack on a [[Law enforcement in Russia|law enforcement]] facility on instructions from [[Ukraine]]. [https://www.straitstimes.com/world/europe/russia-detains-german-citizen-for-terrorist-plot-russian-media-report (AFP via ''The Straits Times'')]
*[[Colombian conflict]]
**[[FARC dissidents]] launch drone strikes on the [[National Army of Colombia|Colombian army]] in [[Ipiales]], [[Nariño Department]], killing three soldiers and wounding two others. [https://apnews.com/article/colombian-soldiers-drone-attack-98c4ad157ef5af342f9f3a56097f5b78 (AP)]

'''Business and economy '''
* [[Apple Inc]] announces that [[Tim Cook]] will step down as [[Chief executive officer]] with senior vice president of hardware engineering [[John Ternus]] taking on the role on September 1. [https://www.reuters.com/technology/john-ternus-become-apple-ceo-tim-cook-become-executive-chairman-2026-04-20/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[List of earthquakes in 2026|Earthquakes in 2026]]
**[[2026 Sanriku Coast earthquake]] 
***[[Earthquakes in Japan|An earthquake]] on a [[Richter scale|scale]] of 7.8 is measured off the coast of [[Sanriku]], [[Japan]]. A subsequent {{convert|80|cm|ft|adj=on}} high [[tsunami]] is reported in [[Kuji, Iwate|Kuji, Iwate prefecture]]. A warning of the risk of potential further [[earthquakes]] at 8.0 was issued shortly after. [https://apnews.com/article/japan-earthquake-tsunami-0746aebae49fc6cc37e20836ca37d570 (AP)] [https://english.kyodonews.net/articles/-/74521 (Kyodo News)]
*At least 21 people are killed and 45 others are injured when a passenger bus rolls into a [[gorge]] in [[Udhampur district]], [[Jammu and Kashmir (union territory)|Jammu and Kashmir]], [[India]]. [https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-news/sharp-curve-loss-of-control-100-ft-plunge-what-caused-jammu-and-kashmir-udhampur-bus-crash-that-left-20-dead-101776671666044.html (''Hindustan Times'')] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/4/20/at-least-21-killed-as-bus-skids-off-kashmir-road-into-gorge (Al Jazeera)]

'''Health and environment'''
*Several [[Central Europe]]an countries, including [[Austria]], [[Slovakia]] and the [[Czech Republic]], begin pulling [[baby food]] produced by [[Hipp Holding]] from [[supermarket]] shelves after [[Rodenticide|rat poison]] was detected in some jars over the weekend. [https://apnews.com/article/rat-poison-baby-food-hipp-austria-e709858e1a0698d2337c264e66498ced (AP)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Argentina–Israel relations]]
**[[2026 state visit by Javier Milei to Israel]]
***[[Argentine President]] [[Javier Milei]] receives the [[Israeli Presidential Medal of Honour]] by [[Israeli President]] [[Isaac Herzog]]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/argentinas-milei-awarded-presidential-medal-of-honor-honorary-bar-ilan-doctorate-for-israel-support/ (''The Times of Israel'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2026 Teotihuacán shooting]]
**A man [[Mass shooting|opens fire]] around the [[Pyramid of the Moon]] in [[Teotihuacán Municipality]], [[Mexico]], killing a tourist from [[Canada]] and wounding six other people, before killing himself. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/4/20/gunman-kills-canadian-woman-injures-more-at-mexicos-teotihuacan-pyramids (Al Jazeera)]
*France is investigating allegations that two Lebanese banks transferred billions of dollars out of the country despite strict capital controls in relation to the [[Lebanese liquidity crisis]] of 2019. [https://www.naharnet.com/stories/319671-france-probes-alleged-illicit-cash-flight-from-lebanon/ (Naharnet)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2026 Bulgarian parliamentary election]], [[2021–present Bulgarian political crisis|Bulgarian political crisis]]
**Preliminary results from yesterday's election reveal that the [[centre-left]] to [[left-wing]] [[Progressive Bulgaria]] coalition, led by former [[President of Bulgaria|president]] [[Rumen Radev]], secured a majority of seats in the [[National Assembly (Bulgaria)|National Assembly]]. [https://apnews.com/article/bulgaria-election-radev-borissov-corruption-russia-oligarchs-2f821c5a659a8ca4ab9dfe28b9138236 (AP)] [https://www.dw.com/en/bulgaria-enters-uncharted-territory-as-radev-wins-big/a-76856059 (DW)]
*The [[Royal Palace of Cambodia|Royal Palace]] of [[Cambodia]] announces in a statement that [[Monarchy of Cambodia|King]] [[Norodom Sihamoni]] has underwent surgery for [[prostate cancer]] in [[Beijing]], [[China]]. [https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/se-asia/cambodian-king-has-successful-surgery-after-cancer-diagnosis (''Strait Times'')]
